messages:
Avery (Product): Quick usability note: during Private setup the Network checks step looks "stuck" when many probes are pending. Users interpret repeated 'waiting' rows as an error.
Jun (Design): Agreed. Current layout shows 3 full rows with dots + tiny timestamps. Idea: collapse active probes into one summary row: '3 checks running • 7s' with 'View details' to expand.
Priya (Eng): Backend emits per-probe events every 2s which causes flicker. We can emit a coalesced `probe_summary` every 3s and immediate `probe_done` for finals. That reduces frontend churn.
Sam (Frontend): UI notes: collapsed row should include a polite aria-live summary, elapsed timer, and a chevron. Expand shows per-probe rows with KB link. Reserve icon space to avoid layout shifts.
Avery (Product): Copy suggestions: header line: 'These checks can take up to 30s depending on network.' Change 'Attempting SSH' -> 'Checking SSH access' and 'Timed out' -> 'No response from host'.
Jun (Design): Also accessibility/contrast: timestamps are too faint on Safari. Bump to 60% gray and ensure 12px minimum. Wrap probe descriptions instead of truncating.
AccessibilityBot: Recommendation: use a single aria-live="polite" on the summary, throttle updates to 1s, announce 'X checks running' only while collapsed, and expose per-probe statuses only on expand. Link: https://a11y.example/live-regions
Priya (Eng): We'll add optional `kb_id` to probe events like 'SSH_EGRESS_BLOCKED' for deep links. Backend will start emitting `probe_summary` in branch `probe-summary`.
Sam (Frontend): I'll mock the collapsed interaction in Figma and prototype the animation for spinner->check crossfade (200ms). Will post link here by Thu EOD.
Mark (PM): Action items: Jun — copy + contrast; Sam — prototype + Figma; Priya — summary events + kb_id; AccessibilityBot notes to be implemented. Target next week.
Avery (Product): Thanks team. Small change but should cut down 'wizard hung' support tickets.
Sam (Frontend): Ack — will include 'What does this mean?' KB CTA on each expanded row.
